column1: # Doctor Rodrigo Gonzalez de Puebla, Spanish ambassador in England, correspondence with Ferdinand/Isabella.
# Transcribed by Satoshi Tomokiyo, Cryptiana (cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/spanish.htm, section "Puebla's Great Roman Numeral Code (1495) (Bergenroth/Puebla-5)"),
# citing William H. Bergenroth's Calendar of Letters, Despatches, and State Papers ... Spain, vol.1 (1862).
# office: Doctor Puebla (Spanish ambassador, England) -> Ferdinand and Isabella
# design: Great Roman-numeral code: number representation (MMCCCLXXIII=1 ... MMMCCCC(read MMCCCC)=1000)
# note: H throughout except the last row (Tomokiyo's own reading correction, graded M)
